major_cooldowns.name: Voidform
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it every 2 minutes once Shadow Word: Pain is on at least as many targets as Vampiric Touch, and pair it with Power Infusion and your on-use trinkets; every Shadow Word: Madness cast inside the window extends it, for roughly 10 extra seconds in practice.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 228260 is the cast id; 194249 is the Voidform aura and is what the Power Infusion rule checks.

major_cooldowns.name: Power Infusion
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it inside Voidform every 2 minutes and sync Fireblood, Berserking, Blood Fury or Ancestral Call to the same window; with Twins of the Sun Priestess cast it on an ally so you get the full buff as well.

major_cooldowns.name: Halo
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Archon only: cast it on cooldown once every mob is engaged and in range, accepting that its 1 minute cooldown drifts further into each Voidform window over the pull.

major_cooldowns.name: Void Torrent
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Voidweaver only: channel it with Shadow Word: Madness active and both DoTs up, early in a burst window so its Insanity fuels the rest of it, and hold it up to 10 seconds in AoE when a pack is about to land.

rule.description: Voidform into Power Infusion, then spend Insanity
rule.action: Pre-cast Vampiric Touch and Tentacle Slam, open with Shadow Word: Pain, then Halo as Archon, Voidform, trinkets and potion, Power Infusion, Shadow Word: Madness, Void Volley, and Void Torrent as Voidweaver.
Both are 2 minute cooldowns, so cast Power Infusion inside every Voidform and pull stat racials and on-use trinkets into the same 15 second window.

rule.description: Shadow Word: Madness before Void Torrent
rule.action: Land Shadow Word: Madness on the target before you channel Void Torrent: every tick re-checks Mastery, so the missing DoT costs damage on the whole 3 second channel.

rule.description: Vampiric Touch stays up on the target
rule.action: Target 99%+ Vampiric Touch uptime on priority targets, refreshing inside the pandemic window at 30% duration remaining, 6.3 seconds with Misery. Prefer Tentacle Slam for the refresh when a charge is up, and skip targets that will not live 12 seconds.

rule.description: Shadow Word: Pain stays up on the target
rule.action: Target 99%+ Shadow Word: Pain uptime, refreshing at 4.8 seconds remaining without Misery or 6.3 with it, and use it as your movement filler when no instant is available.

rule.description: Shadow Word: Madness stays up on the target
rule.action: Target 90%+ Shadow Word: Madness uptime: refresh at under a GCD remaining or once your Insanity deficit is 35 or less. The DoT rolls its remaining damage into the new ticks, so an early refresh to dodge an Insanity cap costs nothing.
